Only 2 of 12 active courses have a read page: General English 089714G (ELICOS, /english-as-a-second-language/) and Certificate IV in Community Services 116306G (/community-services/). The ELICOS fee is 'Elementary 10 Week Module $2,900 + plus application fee ... Pricing for International Students' (per module, not annual; lesson 3 fees), and the Certificate IV fees are 'Pricing for domestic students' ($4,000 / $5,000 / $3,500 Special 2024 introductory price). Both pages print a term timetable ('Term 4: October - December'), which the general reader takes as intakes; these are term date ranges, not start months. Fee (089714G) and intakes (both) excluded by course. No IELTS on the stored pages. 7 Christian ministry, theology and leadership courses are bound to the /courses/ listing page (identity mismatch) and 2 community services courses to a win32.unity.edu.au page that returns 404; no evidenced course URL, so not rebound (needs a person or Layer 2).
